note: Single-polarity accepted. TestCHAPRepeatedResponseAfterSuccessKeepsSessionUp now repeats the Response that earned the Success (challenge Identifier from readCHAPChallengeAndRespond, same 0x33 Value) in the Network-Layer phase: red on EventSessionDown or any lifecycle event, and the session must still answer an LCP Echo-Request. Re-sending the prior reply Code is RFC1994-4.1-9, a recorded gap.
